title: Same person, different name
old_caption: Cole, Dev and Kofi: same silhouette, same three red flags, slightly worse disguise each time. Then a mustache. Then sunglasses. The stars have seen this episode three times. Have you?

title: Photos lie.
old_caption: Good angle, peach filter, taken years ago. Virgo inspected that profile photo with a magnifying glass and was not having it. The chart, on the other hand, passed inspection. How old is your profile photo?

title: Every planet in 30 seconds
old_caption: Ten planets in thirty seconds, and the tour guide star is behind schedule by Mars. Mercury is still typing. Saturn says sit up straight. Which planet runs your life?

title: Rigged
old_caption: Hidden scores. Paid boosts. Scorpio smelled a rat and jumped on the ranking machine until it shattered into stars. No faces, no scores, just stars. What would you smash first?

title: Same moon. Never met.
old_caption: Two lonely windows across Houston, two people sighing at the same moon at 11:48 PM. Their stars yelled 'look right!' and both curtains closed at once. Womp. So the stars drew the line.

title: What's a Saturn return?
old_caption: Saturn takes about 29 and a half years to come back around, then shows up with reading glasses and a clipboard to inspect your career, your choices and your ex. See you at 58. Are you mid-inspection?

title: 312 swipes. 0 butterflies.
old_caption: 312 swipes today and the only butterfly in the picture was asleep on top of the phone. The gold star got so dizzy following the swipes its eyes spun. What's your count today?

title: A city of glass towers
old_caption: A whole tower of signs, each alone in its own glass box on a Friday night. Cancer insists it's a shell, not a box. Then two windows in the same building glow gold. Same building, never met. Ever had a neighbor crush?

title: Two seasons: winter and patio
old_caption: Toronto has two seasons: winter and patio. Leo thawed out, put on sunglasses, and got a date who said 'k.' and left. Patio season is too short for one-word texts. Agree?

title: So polite, nobody says it
old_caption: Sorry. No, sorry. You pick. No, YOU pick. Libra and Virgo stacked polite bubbles until the pile popped, while both secretly wanted the same thing. Toronto, how many sorries before someone says it?
